implementation: New no_std + alloc Doc core depends only on common core. Flat typed arenas and iterative graph validation retain categories, sharing, longest paths and caller depth without recursive ownership cleanup.

Sentence recognition preserves original UTF-8 source windows, nested Ruby/Anno structure, escape boundaries, token-local views, source/origin mappings, typed failure locations and sticky resource stops.

Explicit prefix constructors lower from checked common SyntaxBundle data. Four original Grammar sources are compiled and used by the actual engine with explicit aliases and checked environments; text is not reinterpreted as sentence markup.

Doc schema and grammar include DG01-DG06 table, list, target, code, image and helper values informed by the latest base inventory. Full constructor rendering and documentation migration remain later work.
Same-alias Doc code guests retain independent ForeignClosure values and return to the host context; semantically invalid code examples are not semantically lowered for display.

Doc native and initial CBOR values share structural, source, view, origin and foreign closure validation. Source table order and guest NodeRef identities follow existing common wire canonicalization; owner origins/digests and meaningful source content remain intact.
The minimal descriptor generator change omits zero allocation terms and multiplication by one without altering counts or resource amounts.

independent_review.scope: Eight original Doc probe programs were executed natively and with Wasmtime, covering arenas, sentence cases, normalization/source closure, helper values, foreign closure, real prefix source, same-alias guests and boundaries. Saved binary identities and original source/output records identify these development runs; they are not asserted to link every later frozen WIP file.
independent_review.declarations: Four source-to-seed adapter outputs match original source bytes and all AST metadata. All 64 Doc declarations and 52 distinct Form branch names were checked; this is not all-constructor runtime coverage.
independent_review.root_confirmation: Root executed all six gates on an isolated base plus the frozen Doc changes and independent review. The late contracts.json correspondence note changes no runtime bytes; final contract checks were repeated after it was added.
independent_review.final_review: Huygens independently compared all 57 author-file hashes plus the review snapshot and final Doc contract correspondence; no additional blocking finding. The source/linked-binary limitation remains explicit.

integration: Sixty explicitly frozen source/schema/spec/evidence/review files were hash-checked against their original snapshots and staged Git blobs. Selected CRLF metadata was converted to repository LF in the owner snapshot; source-position fixtures were not changed. Rename WIP is excluded.
log_normalization: Root logs use LF and a final newline. Independent archived UTF-8 text is stored inside JSON strings, preserving each original byte sequence and SHA-256, including any CRLF.
